name: animate-libs
description: Make short procedural animations as single-file canvas videos, in any style, with JavaScript libraries (waapi, gsap, d3, katex, mathjax, lottie, matter, three, glsl) driven frame by frame and deterministic. Twelve built-in styles, an equation path, story / look / storyboard check-ins, then a measured build to MP4. Extends cth9191/animate (MIT).
